app.name: MurMur
app.disclaimer: Research prototype. Not a medical device.
app.pitch: Record 20 seconds of heart sound, hear and see it, get an AI second opinion, write your conclusion.

login.title: Sign in
login.failedBody_one: The username or password is incorrect. You have {{count}} attempt left before sign-in is paused for a while.
login.failedBody_other: The username or password is incorrect. You have {{count}} attempts left before sign-in is paused for a while.
login.noSignup: Accounts are created by your administrator or doctor.
login.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.firstTimeHint: You logged in with a one-time password. Choose a password only you know before you continue.
changePassword.saved: Password saved. Other devices were logged out.
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords are different.
changePassword.tooLong: That password is too long. Use a shorter one.
changePassword.oneTimeRequired: Enter the one-time password you were given.

errors.blocked: This account is blocked. Contact your administrator.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.passwordSame: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.invalidInput: Some fields are not filled in correctly.
errors.notFound: This was not found. It may have been deleted.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this a moment ago. The page shows the latest state.
errors.network: No connection to the MurMur server. Check the Wi-Fi and try again.
errors.server: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.

pages.notAvailableBody: This page belongs to another role.

failure.cancelled: You cancelled this exam before a recording arrived.
failure.tooShort: Too short: {{seconds}} s, at least {{minimum}} s are needed.
failure.silent: Almost silent. Check that the stethoscope touches the skin.
failure.clipped: Too loud: {{percent}} % of the sound is clipped. Press the stethoscope more lightly.
failure.motion: Movement during the recording. Ask the patient to stay still.
failure.quality: The recording quality was too low.
failure.analysis: The analysis failed on the server. The recording is kept; record again or ask the administrator.

patients.title: Patients
patients.emptyBody: Patients you add appear here. Each patient needs signed consent before an exam.
patients.noMatchBody: Check the spelling or search by another part of the name.
patients.deleted: {{name}} was deleted with all their exams and recordings.

shell.note: Research prototype and screening aid, not a medical device.
shell.adminNote: Administrator actions are recorded in the audit log.

patientForm.optional: Optional. For the doctor's record; the current AI model uses only the sound.
patientForm.consentHint: An exam cannot start without it. You can also record it later.
patientForm.leaveBody: Your changes to this patient will be lost.

errors.birthYear: Enter a 4-digit year, not in the future.

patient.noExamsBody: Start the first exam: pick a device and a listening point.
patient.noExamsNeedConsent: Record the patient's consent first, then start an exam.
patient.consentMissingBody: An exam can only start after the patient has signed the consent form.
patient.consentConfirm: I have the consent form signed by the patient.
patient.consentTickFirst: Tick the box to confirm you have the signed form.
patient.loginExists: The patient can log in and see results after your review.
patient.loginMissing: Create a login so the patient can see results you have reviewed.
patient.usernameRule: 3–64 Latin letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
patient.usernameTaken: This username is already taken. Choose another.
patient.resetBody: Their current password stops working at once and they are logged out everywhere.
patient.secretBody: Give these to {{name}} now. The password is shown only once; at first login they choose their own.
patient.secretDone: I gave it to the patient
patient.deleteHint: For a data-deletion request. Removes everything about this patient.
patient.deleteBody_one: This removes the profile, the login, {{count}} exam with its recording and AI result. This can't be undone.
patient.deleteBody_other: This removes the profile, the login, {{count}} exams with their recordings and AI results. This can't be undone.
patient.deleteTypeHint: The delete button unlocks when the name matches.

newExam.title: New exam
newExam.lead: The device records {{seconds}} seconds of heart sound at the point you choose.
newExam.deviceWentOffline: This device went offline. Choose another or check its Wi-Fi.
newExam.choosePoint: Choose where the stethoscope is placed.
newExam.allOffline: All your devices are offline. Turn one on and wait until it shows Online.
newExam.whatHappens: Keep the stethoscope on the point and the patient still for {{seconds}} s.
newExam.noDevices: No device is assigned to you yet. Ask the administrator to assign one.

chest.orientation: You face the patient: the patient's right side (R) is on your left.

where.AV: 2nd intercostal space, right of the sternum
where.PV: 2nd intercostal space, left of the sternum
where.TV: lower left edge of the sternum, 4th space

patientWhere.AV: upper chest, just right of the breastbone
patientWhere.PV: upper chest, just left of the breastbone
patientWhere.TV: lower end of the breastbone, on its left edge
patientWhere.MV: left side of the chest, below the nipple

live.reconnecting: Connection to the server was lost. Reconnecting… The device keeps recording.
live.waitingBody: The device picks it up within a couple of seconds.
live.stuckPower: Is the device switched on and charged?
live.stuckWifi: Is it connected to this laptop's Wi-Fi hotspot?
live.stuckServer: You can cancel this exam and start a new one when the device is Online.
live.recordingBody: Keep the stethoscope still on the point. The patient breathes calmly and does not talk.
live.overdue: The recording should have arrived by now. Check the device's Wi-Fi, or cancel and record again.
live.checkingBody: Usually a few seconds. A recording that is too short, too quiet, clipped or moved is not analysed.
live.readyBody: Listen to the recording, read the AI's opinion, then write your conclusion.
live.reviewedBody: Your conclusion is saved. The patient can see it.

result.audioLoadFailed: The recording could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
result.audioDecodeFailed: This browser could not open the recording. Try Chrome or Edge.

outcomeBody.murmur: The AI flags a recording even at a low murmur probability, so that fewer murmurs are missed. Listen to the recording yourself before you agree or disagree.
outcomeBody.clear: Listen to the recording yourself before you agree or disagree.
outcomeBody.poorQuality: The AI did not judge this recording. Listen yourself, or record again.
outcomeBody.unavailable: The AI model is not connected yet. Your own listening is the conclusion.
outcomeBody.other: This page does not know this answer. Rely on your own listening.

result.disclaimer: Screening aid, not a diagnosis. Your conclusion is the final one.

review.title: Your conclusion
review.agreeQuestion: Do you agree with the AI?
review.agreeRequired: Choose whether you agree with the AI.
review.noteHint: The patient sees this text after you confirm. Write in plain words.
review.final: Once confirmed, the conclusion cannot be changed.
review.leaveBody: Your conclusion is not saved yet. It will be lost.
review.alreadyReviewed: This exam was already reviewed, perhaps in another tab. The saved conclusion is shown below.
review.patientSees: The patient can see this conclusion in their account.

patientHome.title: Your results
patientHome.intro: Your doctor, {{doctor}}, publishes each result here after reviewing it.
patientHome.emptyBody: When your doctor has reviewed an exam, the conclusion appears here.
patientHome.disclaimer: MurMur is a research prototype, not a medical device. If you have questions about a result, ask your doctor.

myResult.title: Result of {{date}}
myResult.mapLabel: Chest diagram: the doctor listened at the {{point}} point
myResult.orientation: Drawn as your doctor sees you: your right side is marked {{right}}.
myResult.notFoundBody: It may have been removed. Your results list shows everything your doctor has published.
myResult.questions: Questions about this result? Ask your doctor.

adminHome.privacy: You see counts only — never recordings, AI results or doctors' notes.
adminHome.aiOff: No AI model is connected: new exams get no AI opinion.

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.addBody: Create a doctor account. You set the first password and hand it to the doctor in person.
doctors.blockBody: The doctor is logged out at once and cannot log in until you unblock them. Their patients and exams stay.
doctors.resetBody: The doctor's open sessions end. Give the new password to the doctor in person.
doctors.handOverBody: Give these to the doctor in person. The password is not shown again.
doctors.emptyBody: Add the first doctor; they can then add patients and start exams.
doctors.shownOnce: The password is shown once after you create the account. The doctor can change it later.
doctors.access1: Only the patients this doctor creates
doctors.access2: Only devices you assign to this doctor
doctors.leaveBody: The doctor's details and password will be lost.
doctors.listBody: All doctors and where they work. Open a profile to see their patients, devices and account status.
doctors.noMatchBody: Clear the search or choose another clinic or status.

devices.title: Devices
devices.addBody: The device gets a secret key, shown once. Put it into the device's firmware settings.
devices.name: Name
devices.serialHint: Printed on the device, e.g. MM-003.
devices.serialTaken: A device with this serial number already exists.
devices.rotateBody: The current key stops working at once. The device stays offline until you put the new key into its firmware.
devices.keyBody: Key for {{name}}. Put it into the firmware now; it is not shown again.
devices.emptyBody: Register the first MurMur device, then assign it to a doctor.

signal.weak: weak, move closer to the hotspot

audit.title: Audit log
audit.about: Every time a doctor or patient opens or changes patient data. Record numbers only.
audit.emptyBody: Entries appear when doctors or patients open patient data.

actions.doctor_patients: Administrator opened a doctor's patient list

profile.ownNote: This is your profile. Your name and clinic are managed by an administrator. You can change your password.
